title: UI Navigation & Telemetry Convergence
summary: Resolved the visibility of the BridgeStatusBar and initiated the Unified Navigation protocol to merge ORC-P and AI-EOS components.
key_findings: BridgeStatusBar was orphaned in the components directory; integrated into main view lifecycle.
Navigation between local OS functions and platform-wide monitoring requires a shared telemetry header.
Dr. Crusher identified a synchronization lag in SSE session monitoring which was mitigated via a 10s heartbeat.
conclusions: The UI is now nominal. Telemetry is persistent. Navigation unifies the Mission Control flow with the Historical Memory Browser.
recommendations: Port the CostOptimizationMonitor from ORC-P to the TaskLLMPanel for real-time ROI tracking.
Implement the Fleet Overview tab to visualize the multiple DDD domains scaffolded at /domains.
